brief: Holds the five rules a network topology must keep and judges a graph made from a network diagram.
detail: The set carries every_device_is_linked, addresses_are_unique and address_in_its_subnet as errors, and switches_form_no_loop and the_edge_is_guarded as warnings, in the network-governance set of the network domain. stzNetworkDiagram builds one for GovernanceFindings and hands it the graph from AsRuleGraph; use the set directly to add a rule of your own before checking.
